relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: SIRT1 deacetylates LKB1 at Lys48 and activates LKB1, leading to AMPK activation by increasing phosphorylation of AMPKa Thr172 (30).

relationships.subject: SIRT6
relationships.evidence_quote: SIRT6 inhibits articular synovial inflammation by promoting M2 polarization and inhibiting M1 polarization (73).

relationships.subject: SIRT3
relationships.evidence_quote: Supplementation with SIRT3 restored SOD2 activity and enhanced cartilage resistance to oxidative stress (44).

key_findings: Review: sirtuins protect chondrocytes in OA via energy metabolism, anti-oxidative stress, anti-inflammation, autophagy and anti-senescence.
SIRT1 and AMPK form a positive feedback loop supporting chondrocyte energy supply.
